summary: Opera Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 earnings. The press release highlights financial results: revenue of $175.8 million (23% YoY growth), adjusted EBITDA of $42.0 million (30% growth), and net income of $24.8 million. The company notes strong execution in advertising and query revenues, product milestones like Browser Connector and MiniPay, and guidance for Q2 and full-year 2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return (beyond a routine semi-annual dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is announced. This is a routine earnings release from a foreign private issuer.
